dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It confirms only when the kitchen can still take it. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still need confirming by you.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items show on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Suits longer menus, where every item always stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows every item in one scrolling list with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you scroll to move around. Suits shorter menus, where you can see almost all of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can send the order now and take the money later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the order screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set up separately. Customers get an email every time an order is marked ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to give a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid as soon as you send an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. If off, you can still give a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but there is no reminder. Useful if you hand out buzzers, and easy to turn off if you do not use them.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off when there is a card problem and customers will order as normal and pay at the truck instead. Orders keep coming in — only the card payment step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This setting applies to your whole Food Truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it back on.
